title: Evidence README miscounts the stepper=off scenario population (56 vs actual 57)
evidence:
The other 56 scenarios run `stepper=off` — `initBrowser` bails before any

Verified against the tree: `find .pi/skills/form-bug-hunt/scenarios -name "*.yaml" | wc -l` returns 59, and `grep -rln "stepper: true"` matches exactly 2 files (save-resume/round-trip.yaml, stepper/stepper-happy-path.yaml), leaving 57 stepper=off scenarios, not 56.
detail: Off-by-one in the shipped evidence artifact. The substantive claim is verified true (the stepper=off bail in initBrowser precedes `var done = seedDoneStates(...)`, so those scenarios never execute changed code); only the count is wrong.
recommended_fix: Change "The other 56 scenarios" to "The other 57 scenarios" (59 total minus the 2 stepper:true drives).

title: New stepper `sectionComplete` collides by name with apply_analytics.js's `sectionComplete`, which has opposite vacuous-section semantics
detail: Two exported same-named predicates with deliberately divergent verdicts now live in the two files the project convention says are kept-in-sync mirrors. No runtime conflict is possible (separately loaded plain scripts, analytics is contractually untouchable), but a future sync pass copying one predicate into the other would silently break a contract.
recommended_fix: Add a one-line cross-reference in each function's comment noting the other file's same-named predicate differs deliberately (vacuous-true+consent-guard vs vacuous-false) and must NOT be synced.
